filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Sun Nov 1 – Mon Nov 2 PT (Sat Oct 31 items only where still current)

market_briefing.lede: AI usage is being sold as one metered pool across chat and agent work: OpenAI will put ChatGPT and Codex on a single token allowance in December. Model vendors are also switching on invisible text watermarks by default ahead of the EU AI Act's December deadline.

bullets.text: Nov 1: OpenAI's updated help page says that from December, Plus, Pro and Business usage will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex and measured in tokens. Instant chat does not count; users who hit the limit can wait, upgrade or buy credits.

Oct 31: Anthropic told API customers it will watermark Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 (newer models already carry it); customers can't turn it off, and on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 it applies only at default sampling settings. xAI's docs say Grok API text is watermarked by default from Nov 7, with a per-model admin opt-out.

Oct 30–Nov 2: Anthropic confirmed it added two sentences to Claude Code's Opus 5.5 prompt to steer it away from recreating specific existing games; developers report reverse-engineering refusals since Oct 31, which Anthropic has not addressed.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts its funding round to $20B
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 30–31: the FT reports OpenAI lowered its target from $30B to $20B, led by UAE investors; the WSJ says $11B is secured so far. OpenAI has not confirmed.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI to merge ChatGPT and Codex usage limits
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 1: one token-based allowance across ChatGPT and Codex for Plus, Pro and Business from December, viewable in Settings → Usage.

biggest_ai_news.title: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 2: a 1.6T-parameter multimodal model (~48B active per token) for long-running agent and coding tasks, live in Meituan's chat and API, with GitHub and Hugging Face releases planned.

what_changed.title: ChatGPT and Codex move to one token allowance in December
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 1: OpenAI's support page says Plus, Pro and Business plans will draw ChatGPT and Codex usage from one token-measured allowance, with heavier models and tasks using more. Instant chat is excluded; extra credits can be bought. OpenAI has not published allowance sizes or an exact date.

what_changed.title: Anthropic extends its text watermark to four more Claude models
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 31: an email to API customers says Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 will be watermarked, citing the EU AI Act December deadline; Bedrock may lag a few days. On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 the mark applies only with default temperature, top_p and top_k. Detection API is in private preview.

what_changed.title: xAI turns on Grok API watermarking by default from Nov 7
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). xAI's docs say text from seven Grok models, including structured outputs and tool-call arguments, is watermarked from Nov 7. Team admins can opt out per model, except models locked on; changes are audit-logged.

what_changed.title: Anthropic confirms a prompt-level guardrail in Claude Code
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Anthropic's Addy Osmani said on Oct 30 that two sentences were added to Claude Code's Opus 5.5 prompt to avoid recreating someone else's specific game. Tom's Hardware (Nov 2) has direct reports of reverse-engineering refusals from Oct 31 that went away on Opus 4.8.

quiet_note: No new launches, pricing, funding or M&A from Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco found for Nov 1–2. Company LinkedIn and X posts in the window were event recaps, culture posts, workshop promos, an internal Clay workflow write-up and founder opinion threads. Salesforce has not yet announced the start of the Agent Evals beta.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (pooled, metered AI budgets)
market_direction.text: OpenAI ChatGPT + Codex shared token allowance from December (Nov 1), after Claude Enterprise pooled group budgets and GitHub Enterprise Copilot usage against one enterprise budget (Oct 28).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (default output watermarking)
market_direction.text: Anthropic adds four more Claude models (Oct 31); xAI Grok API on by default Nov 7; both cite the EU AI Act.

market_direction.label: Emerging (vendor-side prompt guardrails in coding agents)
market_direction.text: Claude Code's Opus 5.5 prompt change on game recreation, confirmed Oct 30, with user reports of reverse-engineering refusals (Oct 31–Nov 2).

market_direction.label: Steady (watchlist)
market_direction.text: No watchlist launches over the weekend; Salesloft summit and Agentforce Coworker demos on Nov 4.

language_pulse.gloss: OpenAI's term for the single token-measured budget shared across ChatGPT and Codex from December (Nov 1).
Anthropic's description of its Claude text watermark, which adds no characters or tokens (Oct 31, via The Decoder).
xAI's label for Grok models where a team cannot opt out of watermarking.

watch.title: Nov 4: Salesloft Behind Every Win summit and Agentforce Coworker demos
watch.body: Salesloft's virtual summit runs 11 AM–1 PM ET (8–10 AM PT) and may give Agentic Playbook pricing or a GA date; Salesforce runs Agentforce Coworker live demos on Salesforce+ the same day. Agent Evals and API Evals are still due to enter beta in November.

interpretation.fact: OpenAI's help page (updated Nov 1) says ChatGPT and Codex will share one token allowance from December. Anthropic emailed API customers (reported Oct 31) that four more Claude models will be watermarked; xAI's docs say Grok API watermarking is on by default from Nov 7. Anthropic confirmed a Claude Code prompt change on Oct 30. The FT and WSJ reported OpenAI cut its round target to $20B. Meituan released LongCat-2.5 on Nov 2. No watchlist launches were found for Nov 1–2.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: agent work is now priced from the same pool as chat, so buyers will compare tools by tokens per task rather than seats. Default watermarking means AI-drafted outbound text from Claude and Grok APIs is detectable by those vendors' tools unless settings or opt-outs change it.
